Unmodified public Mermaid ASCII 1.6.1 stdout, from the frozen executable in the 30 October ecosystem preparation.

Inputs are independently declared in tests/terminal-meaning.test.ts. Observer tests perturb real output to remove labels, reverse arrows and break stems. This bounded profile covers rectangular flowcharts with single-cell labels; other terminal layouts remain unqualified.

`termaid-labelled.txt` and `termaid-branch.txt` are unchanged Termaid 0.10.0 public
`render()` results for the same labelled and branching inputs. The first proves
that a caption above its route is valid; the second retains a rounded shared-stem
layout as unknown rather than accusing that renderer of drawing the wrong graph.
